audit_result.proof_trace: The GET handler performs no authentication or authorization check — there is no call to `supabase.auth.getUser()` and no `is_admin` verification; the only gate is a JST 22:50-23:50 time-window check. The middleware (`src/middleware.ts:30-46`) only validates the presence of `oauth_user_id`/`oauth_access_token` cookies, so any authenticated (non-admin) user passes through. The invoked `forceLogoutAll()` (`src/app/actions.ts:631`) likewise contains no auth check, using the Supabase service-role admin client directly and unconditionally executing a bulk attendance-logout against all active users.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An authenticated non-admin user sends `GET /api/admin/force-logout-all` during the JST 22:50-23:50 window with their regular session cookies; the middleware passes the request (OAuth cookies present), the route handler skips `is_admin` verification, and `forceLogoutAll()` inserts bulk 'out' attendance records for all currently checked-in users — effectively force-clocking-out the entire organization.

PROP-e5782b58-pre-007.text: Admin endpoints must verify is_admin=true at server side before allowing access to management functions.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-007.assertion: forall admin_action(user): user.is_admin == true checked server-side before execution
